_comment: ResNet-18 on ImageNet with topographic regularisation.
All top-level keys can be overridden via CLI (e.g. --epochs 90 --device cuda:1).
null paths resolve to project-root defaults at runtime.
Per-layer keys (topo_scale, factor_h, factor_w, lambda_kl, lambda_entropy, temperature)
must be edited here; they cannot be set from the command line.
temperature: softmax temperature for KL-divergence and entropy computation.
vis_class_indices: list of ImageNet class indices (0-999) to show in selectivity maps.
_comment_hf: HuggingFace fallback: used when data_dir does not contain train/ + val/ sub-dirs.
hf_repo: HuggingFace dataset repo (must have 'train' and 'validation' splits).
hf_train_size / hf_val_size: number of samples to use (0 = full split).
Requires HF_TOKEN env var with access to the repo.
